div.div: Mixture-of-Depths Transformer. As in mixture-of-experts (MoE) transformers we use a router to choose among potential computational paths. But unlike in MoE transformers the possible choices are a standard block’s computation (i.e., self-attention and MLP) or a residual connection. Since some tokens take this second route, Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) transformers have a smaller total FLOP footprint compared to vanilla or MoE transformers.
